$comment: Tracked state for logo requests. This file is the source of truth: docs/logos.html is generated from it plus the shipped catalogue, so a request's status is visible to whoever asked without anyone chasing an issue thread. Edit this file, then run `npm run build:logos` and commit both.

statuses.planned: Accepted. It will ship in a coming release.
statuses.blocked: Cannot ship yet — the reason is stated on the row.
statuses.shipped: In the catalogue. The row links to the mark.
statuses.declined: Will not ship — the reason is stated on the row.

requests.title: NetSuite
requests.note: No icon exists in Simple Icons, and oracle.com refuses automated capture (HTTP 403). Needs a PNG or WebP on an Oracle-owned domain, or a traced vector cleared against Oracle's brand guidelines.

requests.title: Bill.com
requests.note: Only raster art is available in open libraries. A vector redraw is needed before it can ship as a catalogue mark.

requests.title: Plaid
requests.note: Bank-connection layer that appears in most money maps.

requests.title: Brex
requests.note: Spend and card management; pairs with the Ramp mark already shipped.

requests.title: Rippling
requests.note: Payroll and HR, alongside the shipped Gusto mark.

requests.title: QuickBooks
requests.note: The ledger node in every finance map. Shipped with Intuit, Gusto and Chase in the same release.
